746720102.text: What could she want with Lepine-Pauline...?

746720103.text: Pretty please with a cherry on top, Charlotte! Journalist extraordinaire! Please tell me you're joking!

746720104.text: I read that a gang of criminals tricked the Gardemeks by disguising themselves as Blubberbeasts... It's true, isn't it? It has to be!

746720105.text: I've invested all of my savings into Graph Adversarial Technology, and even taken out a sizeable bank loan!

746720106.text: I'm begging you! Begging you like the beggiest beggar in all of begdom!

746720107.text: Okay, okay, I need you to calm down a little, Miss Lepine-Pauline...

746720108.text: I admire your passion for your research, and I don't mean to dash your hopes for those, um... big-ticket orders...

746720109.text: But... I'm afraid I'm not joking. The Blubberbeast incident was a short story mailed to us by an anonymous amateur author, written in the style of a true story.

746720112.text: Oh... Paimon sees what happened here...

746720113.text: Sounds like the "report" Lepine-Pauline read in The Steambird wasn't in the news section after all...

746720114.text: Funnily enough, I actually remember being in a meeting where the editing team was debating the potential risk of misleading the public with this story. They even went to the Maison Gardiennage for advice.

746720115.text: But to our surprise, they fully supported us printing it. They figured that the false intel would be a great way to dupe potential criminals into wearing ridiculous costumes when breaking the law...

746720116.text: In truth, Gardemeks are extremely sophisticated in their capabilities. They can identify criminals just as reliably as the best human Gardes, so a crude disguise isn't gonna get you far. If anything, it'll just make you stand out all the more...

746720117.text: Since we ran that story, the Maison Gardiennage has made a slew of arrests including, uh... one "Phantom Blubberbeast," a "Titanic Redcrown Finch," and a "Specterman"...

746720118.text: So I knew this story had helped out law enforcement, but this is the first time I'm learning of an innocent citizen being deceived by it... And investing so much Mora for nothing...

746720120.text: Uh-oh... so Lepine-Pauline's whole research project is based on a fictional story?

746720121.text: Which means we're not gonna get a big bonus after all? ...But more importantly, she's gonna lose everything she's invested...

746720123.text: I was in the area taking some photos for a story, when I got talking to Miss Lepine-Pauline about her research. She told me about your collaboration.

746720124.text: She was hoping I could write an article to spread awareness about image recognition technology. She even paid me for the article and gave me one of her prototype devices before I could get a word in...

746720125.text: I unfortunately had to dash her hopes, and I'm afraid all your hard work was in vain, too. She's desperately trying to find a way to rescue the project and get you the Mora you're due... I've tried to let her down gently, but she's finding it all very hard to accept.

746720126.text: This is a new situation for us, too...

746720127.text: It's such a pity... It seems like the author was only trying to make the story interesting, and the Maison Gardiennage only had Fontaine's best interest in mind...

746720219.text: Uh-oh, she really sounds like she's in pain... Umm... Paimon thinks we should just ask Charlotte what is going on.

746720222.text: I was in the area taking some photos for a story, when I got talking to Miss Lepine-Pauline about her research.

746720223.text: She read an article in The Steambird about a criminal who evaded Gardemek detection by disguising themselves as a Blubberbeast.

746720224.text: Inspired by this story, she spent a lot of Mora researching counter-criminal image recognition technology. Her aim was to improve Fontaine's public security by developing a device that could enhance Gardemeks' target-recognition capabilities...

746720225.text: She was hoping I could write an article to spread awareness about image recognition technology. She even paid me for the article and gave me one of her prototype devices before I could get a word in...

746720226.text: But unfortunately, it was just a fictional story, and her efforts and aspirations were all in vain... I tried to let her down gently, but she's finding it all very hard to accept.

746720228.text: It's such a pity... It seems like the author was only trying to make the story interesting, and the Maison Gardiennage only had Fontaine's best interest in mind...

746729901.text: Okay! That should be all the images we need!

746729902.text: Let's head back and check in with Lepine-Pauline. Maybe she'll have an update for us!
